grok.lens: Quantitative/resource final recheck. Audit constants, all quantifiers, pointwise vs full-rank and tangent vs global repair; check the revised abstract, ln notation and claim ranges. Confirm or reject this exact final source after your initial review.

agy.lens: Non-claims/attribution final recheck. Check exact revised abstract, domain pages, metadata and public-draft status. Uniform metric is the stated scope; do not relabel it Fisher-Rao. Finite positive times at the witness are enough; variable times with boundary singular behavior change hypotheses. No assertion of archival priority or publication readiness from reviewer approval.
